race.comment: As far as 3800m Highweights go, this isn't a bad edition. FEDERER (3) has been a bit of a tease of late, hitting a flat spot before getting home well without really threatening to win. He might be at the point of his career where he's looking for this trip and certainly no knock that Steve Pateman has been engaged to ride. Omen players might want to take him a quinella with No 10 - TOPSPIN - but those concentrating on form will probably consider THE CUNNING FOX (4) the main danger. A top jumper who has won out to 3900m, he's also still adept on the flat in the right class of race, as he demonstrated last start. Right in this. DIWALI (2) is another down in class, up in trip. He's got the talent to be a force. GENRICHERO (7) didn't have the best of luck last start and can improve.
